svg.aria-label: SD card layout of STACK=st, ST's own: GPT with fsbla1 at sector 34 and fsbla2 holding BL2, metadata1 and metadata2 holding the firmware-update metadata, fip-a and fip-b holding two copies of the FIP with fixed PARTUUIDs that the metadata names, u-boot-env for U-Boot's environment, and an ext4 rootfs from 16 MiB with /boot/extlinux/extlinux.conf, the kernel Image and ST's device tree.
svg.text: STACK=st: the SD card in ST's own layout
Eight partitions, back to back from 17 KiB. BL2 first reads a small metadata record that says which of two FIP partitions to load.
fsbla1 starts at 17 KiB = sector 34, right after the GPT
fsbla1, and fsbla2 if the first
copy is bad. Sector 34 is the

• the same partitions as ST's own SD image
• names and GUIDs the ROM and BL2 expect
• fsbla1 at 17 KiB, exactly as in ST's image,
so the Boot ROM sees what it sees there
• one FIP in two places, one record that
Sizes, GUIDs and PARTUUIDs: config/stack-st.conf and config/stm32mp257f-dk.conf. FWU metadata: U-Boot tools/mkfwumdata; BL2 side: plat/st/common/bl2_io_storage.c in ST's TF-A.
Compare with the mainline stack's five partitions in sd-layout.svg: the partition names, type GUIDs and the rootfs are the same; fip is split in two and the metadata is new.
